text: Li Ronan asks the viewer to memorise a symbol and chant a blessing for her six-year-old daughter Dodo, who is under a curse. Six years earlier, pregnant and filming for an online channel, Ronan and two companions visited a remote mountain village in Yunnan, where a clan worships Mother-Buddha, and [entered a tunnel the villagers had forbidden|trigger|breaking a rule]. Now runes spread across [Dodo's small body|wrong|harm done to children], the priests who try to help her die violently, and the [restored tunnel footage kills whoever watches it|images|pictures, screens and recordings].
